# quest_teleop_2 (third-party, do not edit)

Teleoperation and recording for the UR5e + Wuji Hand 2 + Quest 3 + tactile glove,
written by Gregorio Valenti (EPFL). Used in this thesis as an unchanged library,
with his permission to publish it here.

- Received: 2026-11-25, as a zip from Gregorio Valenti (gregorio.valenti@epfl.ch)
- Version: Zip of 2026-11-25


Rules: nothing in this folder is edited. Behaviour that must differ is overridden or
subclassed in `source/tunable_comp_real/`; a file that has to be copied gets a header
naming its origin here.
